scope: reference SQL under four conditions: exported file, after ANALYZE on a copy, written join order kept, MATERIALIZED hint; read-only on the exported files

design.percentile: linear interpolation between order statistics, position (n - 1) * q
design.analyzeOn: copies in the work folder, removed at the end

queries.reference: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.orderedJoin: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later CROSS JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id CROSS JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id CROSS JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id CROSS JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id CROSS JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
